name: Tsukimiya Lilith
source:
Queen of the Ring with hidden fangs
She is a heel wrestler who usually works as a freelancer. She is a highly adaptable and talented wrestler who can change her fighting style depending on the ring she is in. Her glamorous, dynamite body and alluring aura make her a very popular wrestler. In contrast to her rough fighting style in the ring, she is a rich and elegant young lady. However, in reality she has the temperament of a super sadistic queen. She is ambidextrous and has a sexual fetish for tormenting girls who are cute and worthy of bullying. She has her sights set on Aomi Hinata, who she faced the previous time she was in the DEAR ring.

"Now, cry some more!"
